fit.model: P = a + b·kT (per-run means, all runs)

temperatureDependence.interpretation: Rigid-contact model: kT is not an independent parameter (time-rescaling symmetry). Runs whose kT differ by a power of 4 are the same trajectory in rescaled time (bit-for-bit); other ratios are independent chaotic realisations. Non-trivial temperature dependence needs a model with an energy scale (soft contact K, occupancy ks, wall temperature).

uncertainty.note: Statistical: independent-seed ensembles (Student t). Per-run block SEs are reported only as perRunSePooled and are not used (they overstate closed-box pressure scatter). Systematic/numerical errors (timestep, grid, finite size) are in the static-box convergence records, not in these intervals.

acceptance.description: No run halted by the safety monitor

acceptance.criterion: no POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE flag

acceptance.description: Elastic runs conserve energy (the kT proxy is fixed by it)
Same-seed runs at kT differing by a power of 4 give identical P/(nkT) (exact time-rescaling symmetry, exact in binary floating point)
P/(nkT) is the same at every temperature class (independent realisations)
acceptance.criterion: one-way ANOVA over independent runs (one kT per class) p > 0.05/3 (FAIL if p < 1e-6)

acceptance.description: Every initial distribution reaches the same equilibrium pressure and velocity-distribution shape
acceptance.criterion: one-way ANOVA over independent runs, p > 0.05/3, for P/(nkT) and for late-time a2 across distributions (FAIL if p < 1e-6)

acceptance.description: Every non-Maxwell start is indistinguishable from the equilibrium-start (Maxwell) control in the late half of the relaxation run (a2, anisotropy; per-seed block means, Welch t)
acceptance.criterion: 24 tests, each p > 0.05/24 = 2.08e-3 (Bonferroni, family-wise false alarm ≤ 5 %); FAIL if any p < 1e-6
acceptance.measured: 0 of 24 violations; smallest p = 0.0863 (uniform-speed / anisotropy / block 3), max |t| = 1.83

acceptance.description: Late half equals early half of the measurement (Z, a2, kurtosis, anisotropy, dispersion; every distinct configuration)
acceptance.criterion: seed-paired t-test p > 0.05/40 = 1.25e-3 for all 40 tests (FAIL if any p < 1e-6)
acceptance.measured: all pass; smallest p = 8.88e-2 (uniform-speed start, φ = 0.05 (late half of the relaxation run) / Z)
